## SD01 — Statistical Thinking

Source deck: Samer El Kababji, **SD01 — Statistical Thinking**.
These companions turn applicable ideas into mathematics followed immediately
by R code. Simulations extend the concepts and are labeled as fictional.
The four displayed loan records are transcribed from the deck.

| Companion | Focus |
|---|---|
| [SD01-01: Data Matrices and Variables](SD01-01-data-matrices-and-variables.Rmd) | Rows, columns, variable types, and shared-cause association |
| [SD01-02: Covariates, Confounding, Association, and Causation](SD01-02-covariates-confounding-and-causation.Rmd) | Group comparisons without regression |
| [SD01-03: Populations and Sampling](SD01-03-populations-and-sampling.Rmd) | Simple, stratified, cluster, multistage, and convenience samples |

## SD02 — Exploratory Data Analysis

Source deck: Samer El Kababji, **SD02 — Exploratory Data Analysis**.

| Companion | Focus |
|---|---|
| [SD02-01: Descriptive Statistics and Quantiles](SD02-01-descriptive-statistics-and-quantiles.Rmd) | Mean, variance, proportion, median, and linearly interpolated quartiles |
| [SD02-02: Shape and Univariate Plots](SD02-02-shape-and-univariate-plots.Rmd) | Dot plots, histograms, skewness, kurtosis, modes, and box plots |
| [SD02-03: Comparing Variables with Plots](SD02-03-comparing-variables-with-plots.Rmd) | Scatter plots, categorical bar plots, grouped box plots, and violin plots |

## SD03a — Probabilities

Source deck: Samer El Kababji, **SD03a — Probabilities**.

| Companion | Focus |
|---|---|
| [SD03a-01: Sample Spaces, Events, and Probability Rules](SD03a-01-sample-spaces-and-probability-rules.Rmd) | Outcomes, events, complements, set operations, axioms, and addition rules |

## Run the companions

Open any `.Rmd` file in RStudio and run its R chunks from top to bottom, or
use **Knit** to create HTML. Every lesson is independent and uses base R.
Rendering requires `knitr` and `rmarkdown`. From this folder:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rmarkdown::render("SD01-01-data-matrices-and-variables.Rmd")
```
:::


The separate [Advanced Statistical Modeling](../advanced-statistical-modeling/index.qmd)
course contains the existing logistic and mixed-effects regression lessons.
